categories.name: Cricket
categories.description: Roles: batter, bowler (fast / spin), wicket-keeper, fielder; all-rounder combines them.

categories.name: Lawn Tennis
categories.description: No player roles; practice is organised by stroke area (serve, return, groundstrokes, net, movement) and match play.

categories.name: Badminton
categories.description: No player roles; singles and doubles share the same stroke library.

categories.name: Athletic Conditioning
categories.description: Shared by all sports: speed, agility, plyometrics, fitness tests, injury prevention, load monitoring.

parameterSets.name: Weighted set
parameterSets.description: One row per working set with external load.

parameterSets.name: Body-weight set
parameterSets.description: Reps with optional added load (vest/belt) or assistance (band/machine).

parameterSets.name: Timed hold
parameterSets.description: Isometric holds and carries measured by time.

parameterSets.name: Loaded carry
parameterSets.description: Farmer's walk, suitcase carry, sled push/pull.

parameterSets.name: Cardio bout / interval
parameterSets.description: Steady-state piece or one interval on a machine or outdoors.

parameterSets.name: Sprint / timed run rep
parameterSets.description: Short timed effort over a fixed distance or course.

parameterSets.name: Jump / throw effort
parameterSets.description: Plyometric or ballistic effort measured by height or distance.

parameterSets.name: Mobility / stretch
parameterSets.description: Stretch, mobility drill or soft-tissue work.

parameterSets.name: Drill block (attempts vs successes)
parameterSets.description: Generic block: N attempts, M successful – for target and execution drills.

parameterSets.name: Session load (sRPE)
parameterSets.description: Foster session-RPE training load: RPE × minutes.

activities.name: Fast Bowling – Delivery (ball by ball)
activities.description: Log every ball in nets or a spell: pace, line/length, and attempted → accurate for each skill (yorker, seam, bouncer, swing, slower ball).

activities.name: Target / Cone Bowling Drill
activities.description: Blocks of N balls at a marked target; success = landed in the zone.

activities.name: Bowling Workload Check-in
activities.description: Daily ball count + session RPE for workload monitoring (Foster sRPE).

activities.name: Batting – Ball Faced (nets / throw-downs)
activities.description: One row per ball faced: what came (feed, line, length), what was played, and quality of contact.

activities.name: Batting Shot Drill (block)
activities.description: Blocks of throw-downs on one shot; success = executed as intended.

activities.name: Yo-Yo Intermittent Recovery Test Level 1
activities.description: 40 m shuttles with 10 s active recovery; widely used in cricket and football fitness selection.

activities.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
activities.description: Eccentric hamstring exercise used in injury-prevention programmes.

templates.name: Fast Bowler
templates.description: Pace bowler: ball-by-ball nets/spell logging with attempted → accurate skills, target drills, figures, workload, and key S&C.

templates.name: Tennis Player
templates.description: No roles: one profile covering serve, return, groundstrokes, net play, consistency and match stats.
